body.name: Censoring-aware finite-sample outer set
body.construction: Fix \(0=a_0<\cdots<a_m=\tau\) and readmission bins \(B_j\). In cell \((z,x)\), give every observable moment \(A^{zx}_{ij}\), \(Y^{zx}_i\), and \(V^{zx}_j\) an interval centered at its empirical proportion, clipped to \([0,1]\), with radius \(\sqrt{\log(2J/\alpha)/(2N_{zx})}\) when \(N_{zx}>0\), and use \([0,1]\) when \(N_{zx}=0\). Give \(p_x\) the interval centered at \(\widehat p_x\), clipped to \([0,1]\), with radius \(\sqrt{\log(2J/\alpha)/(2n)}\). Define \(\mathscr E_n\) as the event on which all these primitive intervals cover simultaneously. Define \(\mathcal B_n\) as all tuples of probability tables \(\pi^{zx}_{ij},\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}\), covariate masses \(p_x\), censoring vectors \(g^{zx}_i\), and candidate observable moments \(A^{zx}_{ij},Y^{zx}_i,V^{zx}_j\) such that every candidate lies in its corresponding interval, the table obeys simplex and event-order restrictions, and, for every \((z,x,i,j)\), \(g^{zx}_{i+1}\pi^{zx}_{ij}\le A^{zx}_{ij}\le g^{zx}_i\pi^{zx}_{ij}\), \(Y^{zx}_i=g^{zx}_i\{\sum_{h\ge i,j}\pi^{zx}_{hj}+\sum_j\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}\}\), \(V^{zx}_j=g^{zx}_m\pi^{zx}_{\infty j}\), and \(1\ge g^{zx}_0\ge\cdots\ge g^{zx}_m\ge\gamma\). For a discrete exact-death grid replace the first pair of inequalities by \(A^{zx}_{ij}=g^{zx}_i\pi^{zx}_{ij}\). Define \(\mathcal C_n\) as the union of the exact chain-flow surface images over \(\mathcal B_n\).
